description: Documents existing 26-variable semantics. New strict snapshots do not make legacy model validation valid.

observationFields.entityId: Participant ID or event ID in scope
observationFields.value: Typed value; null only with a reason, never used in model vector
observationFields.source: provider + recordId + revision + kind(provider/fixture); manual origin is not eligible for model input + publishedAt
observationFields.capturedAt: First captured at UTC instant, not import time
observationFields.availableAt: Earliest documented availability; >= publishedAt and <= capturedAt
observationFields.measuredAt: End of measured period, <= availableAt; event schedule future goes in event.startsAt
observationFields.missingReason: Required for null; null never becomes zero
observationFields.rawValue: Original before explicit clipping, when applicable

scopeFields.event: id, sport, league, season, period, startsAt, timezone, participants[2]
scopeFields.asOf: Prediction cutoff UTC milliseconds ISO; < startsAt and <= now
scopeFields.purpose: inference or training_features; targets are separate
scopeFields.origin: observed, manual or fixture; never upgraded automatically
scopeFields.previousHash: null or hash of earlier immutable snapshot
